items.title: Bitcoin is about to get a major bullish signal it hasn't had in over a year
items.desc: Key price averages are on the verge of confirming a major bullish configuration for the first time in over a year.

items.title: Ethereum investors are stuck in a two-week staking exit line. Here's why.
items.desc: Ether waiting to enter staking has fallen by more than a quarter since early September, while the exit queue hit its longest of 2026.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.desc: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Zcash’s 25-second blocks go live on public testnet ahead of schedule
items.desc: NU7 cuts the target block time from 75 seconds to 25, giving exchanges, wallets and developers a live rehearsal before a planned November mainnet launch.

items.title: Bitcoin zooms toward $87,000, nearly setting an eight-month high, then reverses
items.desc: Bitcoin came within about $500 of its late-September peak before sellers pushed it back under $86,000. It's the second rally in a week to stall.

items.title: Ether's bitcoin-beating Q3 rally came with a catch. Liquidity thinned.
items.desc: Ether beat bitcoin in the third quarter, but its market liquidity got thinner, according to Coingecko.

items.title: Zcash activates NU7 on testnet ahead of November mainnet target
items.desc: Zcash’s NU7 upgrade is now live on testnet, giving developers several weeks to assess 25-second blocks and other protocol changes before a planned November mainnet activation.

items.title: OKX, NYSE parent file to launch tokenized US stock platform
items.desc: The stock trading platform seeks to offer tokenized shares in more than 60 US-listed companies under the SEC’s recently introduced innovation exemption.

items.title: Safe investor asks Swiss watchdog to intervene in governance dispute
items.desc: Greenfield Capital said it sought changes to Safe Ecosystem Foundation’s board for months before turning to the Swiss regulator.

items.title: Zcash gets a Washington lobbyist to push crypto policy
items.desc: The newly registered lobbying operation lists the CLARITY Act and two digital asset tax proposals among the issues it plans to lobby on in Washington.

items.title: There's an election next month: State of Crypto
items.desc: Congress is gone from Washington for the final pre-election recess, and it's time to take stock of what's going on ahead of November.

items.title: Banking Group Sues to Block Crypto's 'Side Door' Into the Banking System
items.desc: The Independent Community Bankers of America argues the OCC's national trust charters give crypto firms a "side door into the banking system" without the safeguards that bind traditional banks.

items.title: 'Uptober' Starts Green as Bitcoin ETFs Draw $134 Million
items.desc: Spot Bitcoin ETFs took in $134.4 million over the first two trading days of October, rebounding from a Sept. 30 outflow as a weak jobs report cooled Fed rate-hike bets.

items.title: Crypto poured years into new products. The next challenge is keeping users
items.desc: Crypto firms have spent years building financial products on blockchains. Getting people to use them — and keep using them — is becoming the next challenge.

items.title: 'We Have Identified You, Sir': Near Intents Recovers $3.8 Million After 48-Hour Ultimatum
items.desc: Near Intents said the roughly $3.8 million drained in an exploit on Thursday was returned in full, a day after the team said it had identified the attacker and gave them 48 hours to return the funds.

items.title: The Clarity Act stalled. Bankers aren’t hitting the brakes yet on crypto dealmaking
items.desc: Crypto M&A has hit record levels, but the Clarity Act’s Senate setback leaves dealmakers weighing how much regulatory uncertainty still matters.

items.title: Japan adds Garantex to list of Russia sanctions over Ukraine war
items.desc: Garantex was previously sanctioned by the US, the EU and other jurisdictions for helping Russian entities evade financial restrictions.

items.title: El Salvador receives $138 million from IMF after Bitcoin waivers granted
items.desc: Efforts will continue to reduce the state’s involvement in Bitcoin-related activities and to strengthen crypto‑asset regulation and governance, the IMF said.

items.title: Russia’s Finance Ministry pays wages in digital rubles for first time
items.desc: Work on the introduction of the digital ruble to the budget process is being carried out by the Bank of Russia together with the Ministry of Finance.

items.title: Payments firm OpenPayd targets year-end Nasdaq listing to fund U.S. expansion and acquisitions
items.desc: CEO Iana Dimitrova said OpenPayd aims to launch in the U.S. by April 2027 and is eyeing deals to add licenses and technology.

items.title: Crypto job postings triple to over 1,200 in September, but applications fall
items.desc: Finance, engineering and trading led hiring demand, while Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana were the most frequently requested blockchain skills.

items.title: Crypto's Sisyphean struggle
items.desc: Progress will effectively reset when the new Congress is sworn in, because key senators who quarterbacked the bill will not be on the ballot again, writes the Cato Institute's Ryan Chan-Wei.

items.title: NEAR Intents recovers entire stolen $3.8M after ultimatum to exploiter
items.desc: The exploiter returned the entire sum to NEAR Intents after being identified and given 48 hours to respond.

items.title: Community banks sue OCC over trust bank charters of crypto firms
items.desc: Community banking group’s lawsuit claims OCC has overstepped its mandate from Congress.

items.title: Hyperliquid’s USDC Yield Program Gets $14.6 Million for HYPE Buybacks
items.desc: The first reserve-yield payment awaits transfer to the Assistance Fund, adding buyback funding tied to USDC balances rather than trading volume.
